requirement: Build from my business finds any trade, picks a template made for that trade, writes a business brief, and keeps the customer's chat message to one sentence

oracle.invariant: S1: health, food, beauty, professional, other; the dentist and the restaurant kept with their trades, the town left out; without anyKind only the restaurant. S2: ja-vital, ja-spa, ja-resort, ja-sensei, ja-rent; ja-smallbiz for the five without a trade card; never a restaurant, magazine, band or resume template. S3: a valid brief with business.trade health, no menu page, a menu miss about services and prices, no word restaurant. S4: links and names told apart; the business question or null; /<site>/s/<session>?wo-demo-chat=<action> only for a same-site href; one prepare and one open after research; failed with the server code; STOPPED. S5: the customer's own business named, the steps present; no demo or pilot wording.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
